Name: Death March
Description: At the start of your turn, you and all undead allies move 2 tiles towards the closest enemy.

Name: Restless Dead
Description: When an enemy casts a spell, move 2 tiles toward the closest enemy.

Name: Mindless Undead
Description: You are immune to Poison, Charm, Probed, Fear, and Possessed.
Notes: Poison immunity should probably by default.

Name: Shallow Graves
Description: When you take damage equal to or more than your [img:con], unearth a body on an adjacent tile.
Notes: Still deciding whether to keep this or not

Name: More... Brains!
Description: The first time you Feast each turn, refresh your movement action.
Upgraded Description: Whenever you Feast, refresh your movement action.

Name: Glory in Death
Description: The first time you are downed each battle, revive to 1 HP with Doomed 2 and gain 2 bonus turns with Full Mana, Invulnerability, and Madness.
Upgraded Description: Whenever you are downed, revive to 1 HP with Doomed 2 and gain 2 bonus turns with Full Mana, Invulnerability, and Madness.

Name: Already Dead
Description: Start each battle at 50% health. The first time you are downed each battle, gain a random permanent stat.
Upgraded Description: Start each battle at 50% health. Whenever you are downed, gain a random permanent stat.

Name: Cordyceps
Description: You are AI controlled and have 2 extra dispersed turns each round.

Name: Thriller
Description: Your movement action is a unique dash attack. You can use your movement action two extra times each turn.

Name: Dawn of the Dead
Description: Start each battle with 2 zombie familiars near you.
Upgraded Description: Start each battle with 2-3 [img:champion] zombie familiars near you.

Name: Here They Come...
Description: When an enemy takes damage, you and all undead familiars move 1 tile towards the closest enemy.

Name: Master of Puppets
Description: Your undead familiars are no longer AI controlled.

Name: For We Are Many
Description: The buffs you and your familiars gain from Feast are shared.

Name: Rule #1: Cardio
Description: When a body is destroyed, you and all familiars gain +1 [img:spd] until the end of your next turn.

Name: We're All Infected
Description: Enemies that die while inflicted with Poison are immediately resurrected as undead familiars.

Name: You Alerted The Horde!
Description: You and your familiars gain +3 [img:spd] while adjacent to each other.

Name: Fallen Comrade
Description: Start each battle with a random collared cat. It is a zombie and has random equipment.

Name: Hive Mind
Description: Gain two exact copies of yourself. Start each battle with half your stats except [img:cha] and [img:int], which are only reduced by a quarter.
Notes: proud of how this turned out.

Name: Putrid Scent
Description: At the start of your turn, trigger the Poison effects on all units within range 3.

Status: Lots of these won't make it to the final version
